summary: Backend regression and authenticated desktop/mobile UI flows passed after fixing route-change React runtime crash.

integration_issues.issue: External Emergent OAuth redirect/callback was not exercised in this environment

action_items: Exercise Google OAuth with an allowed test identity in a dedicated auth environment
Require JWT_SECRET in production rather than generating a random fallback
critical_code_review_comments: JWT_SECRET falls back to a process-random value, invalidating all sessions after restart; environment configuration should fail fast for production.
seed_data_creation: Created one uniquely named temporary registration account during API testing and one watchit.ui.test@example.com account for browser testing.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Registration/login cookie session, /api/auth/me, dashboard, HAL detail, insights, logout, settings controls, and mobile menu passed. Google OAuth remains externally unverified.
rca of the issue: Initial browser route navigation to HAL crashed with 'destroy is not a function'. StockDetail and Insights useEffect callbacks directly returned fetch promises; React interpreted the Promise as an effect cleanup function during unmount. Wrapping the async chains in braces makes the callbacks return undefined and resolves the crash.
